name: Alchemist

features.name: Tools of the Trade
features.summary: Gain Alchemist's Supplies and Herbalism Kit proficiency (another Artisan's Tool for each you already had). Brewing potions takes half the usual time.

features.name: Alchemist Spells
features.summary: Always prepared at levels 3, 5, 9, 13 and 17: Healing Word, Ray of Sickness; Flaming Sphere, Acid Arrow; Gaseous Form, Mass Healing Word; Death Ward, Vitriolic Sphere; Cloudkill, Raise Dead.

features.name: Experimental Elixir
features.summary: Each Long Rest with Alchemist's Supplies, brew 2 elixirs (3 at level 5, 4 at 9, 5 at 15) and roll a d6 for each one's effect; leftovers vanish at the next Long Rest. Spend a spell slot as a Magic action to brew one more and pick its effect. Drinking or feeding one within 5 ft is a Bonus Action.

options.name: Healing
options.summary: Heals 2d8 + your INT mod; 3d8 at level 9, 4d8 at 15.

options.name: Swiftness
options.summary: +10 ft Speed for 1 hour; +15 ft at level 9, +20 ft at 15.

options.name: Resilience
options.summary: +1 AC for 10 minutes; 1 hour at level 9, 8 hours at 15.

options.name: Boldness
options.summary: Add 1d4 to attack rolls and saves for 1 minute; 10 minutes at level 9, 1 hour at 15.

options.name: Flight
options.summary: Fly Speed 10 ft for 10 minutes; 20 ft at level 9, 30 ft at 15.

features.name: Alchemical Savant
features.summary: Casting through Alchemist's Supplies, add your INT mod (min +1) to one healing roll or one Acid, Fire or Poison damage roll of the spell.

features.name: Restorative Reagents
features.summary: Cast Lesser Restoration through Alchemist's Supplies with no slot and no need to prepare it, INT mod times (min 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Chemical Mastery
features.summary: Acid, Fire or Poison spells can add 2d8 Force damage once a turn; Resistance to Acid and Poison and immunity to Poisoned; a free Tasha's Bubbling Cauldron through your supplies once per Long Rest.

options.name: Alchemical Eruption
options.summary: Once your Artificer spell hits a target with Acid, Fire or Poison damage, add 2d8 Force to it. Once per turn.

options.name: Chemical Resistance
options.summary: Resistance to Acid and Poison damage; can't be Poisoned.

options.name: Conjured Cauldron
options.summary: Once per Long Rest, cast Tasha's Bubbling Cauldron through Alchemist's Supplies with no slot, preparation or materials.

summary: A potion-brewer who hands out random elixirs and boosts acid, fire, poison and healing magic.

name: Armorer

features.name: Tools of the Trade
features.summary: Heavy armor training and Smith's Tools proficiency (or another Artisan's Tool if you had them). Crafting armor takes half the time.

features.name: Armorer Spells
features.summary: Always prepared at levels 3, 5, 9, 13 and 17: Magic Missile, Thunderwave; Mirror Image, Shatter; Hypnotic Pattern, Lightning Bolt; Fire Shield, Greater Invisibility; Passwall, Wall of Force.

features.name: Arcane Armor
features.summary: Magic action with Smith's Tools: the armor you wear becomes Arcane Armor until you swap suits or die. It ignores Strength requirements, dons or doffs as a Utilize action, can't be pulled off you, and works as your spellcasting focus.

features.name: Armor Model
features.summary: Choose a model for your Arcane Armor, changeable on a Short or Long Rest with Smith's Tools. Each has a built-in weapon that uses INT for attack and damage.

options.name: Dreadnaught
options.summary: A heavy-hitting juggernaut: a reach hammer that shoves or drags, and the power to grow to Large.

options.name: Force Demolisher
options.summary: Simple melee weapon with Reach, 1d10 Force. On a hit against a smaller creature, push it away or pull it in up to 10 ft.

options.name: Giant Stature
options.summary: Bonus Action: for 1 minute gain +5 ft reach and grow to Large if smaller and there's room. INT mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

options.name: Guardian
options.summary: A front-liner: blows that make foes focus on you, and temp HP when Bloodied.

options.name: Thunder Pulse
options.summary: Simple melee weapon, 1d8 Thunder. A creature it hits has Disadvantage attacking anyone but you until your next turn starts.

options.name: Defensive Field
options.summary: Bonus Action while Bloodied: gain temp HP equal to your Artificer level; they go away if you take the armor off.

options.name: Infiltrator
options.summary: A stealth suit: a long-range lightning shooter, +5 ft Speed, and Advantage on Stealth checks.

options.name: Lightning Launcher
options.summary: Simple ranged weapon, range 90/300, 1d6 Lightning; once on each of your turns a hit can add another 1d6 Lightning.

options.name: Powered Steps
options.summary: Your Speed goes up by 5 ft.

options.name: Dampening Field
options.summary: Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks, offsetting any Disadvantage the armor imposes.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.summary: Taking the Attack action on your turn gives you two attacks.

features.name: Improved Armorer
features.summary: Learn one extra plan that must be Armor (replace it only with Armor) and make one extra Armor item with Replicate Magic Item. Your model's special weapon gains +1 to attack and damage.

features.name: Perfected Armor
features.summary: Each model gets stronger: bigger weapon dice plus a new trick (a larger Dreadnaught, a Guardian that yanks foes in, an Infiltrator that marks targets and briefly flies).

options.name: Dreadnaught
options.summary: Force Demolisher deals 2d6. Giant Stature grants +10 ft reach, lets you become Large or Huge, and gives Advantage on Strength checks and saves.

options.name: Guardian
options.summary: Thunder Pulse deals 1d10. Reaction when a Huge or smaller creature you see ends its turn within 30 ft: it makes a STR save or is pulled up to 25 ft toward you, and if it lands adjacent you may make a melee weapon attack on it. INT mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

options.name: Infiltrator
options.summary: Lightning Launcher deals 2d6; creatures it shocks glow (dim light, 5 ft) and have Disadvantage attacking you until your next turn. Bonus Action: Fly Speed of twice your Speed this turn, INT mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

summary: A tinkerer who rebuilds their own armor into a weaponized second skin with a swappable model.

name: Artillerist

features.name: Tools of the Trade
features.summary: Proficiency with Martial Ranged weapons and Woodcarver's Tools (or another Artisan's Tool if you had them). Crafting a magic Wand takes half the time.

features.name: Artillerist Spells
features.summary: Always prepared at levels 3, 5, 9, 13 and 17: Shield, Thunderwave; Scorching Ray, Shatter; Fireball, Wind Wall; Ice Storm, Wall of Fire; Cone of Cold, Wall of Force.

features.name: Eldritch Cannon
features.summary: Magic action with Smith's or Woodcarver's Tools: build a Small or Tiny cannon within 5 ft (AC 18, HP 5 × Artificer level, immune to Poison and Psychic) lasting 1 hour; once per Long Rest or by spending a spell slot, one at a time. Bonus Action within 60 ft: it moves up to 15 ft and fires one mode.

options.name: Flamethrower
options.summary: 15-ft Cone: DEX save, 2d8 Fire on a fail, half on a success; sets loose flammable objects alight.

options.name: Force Ballista
options.summary: Ranged spell attack from the cannon at a target within 120 ft: 2d8 Force and a creature is shoved 5 ft away.

options.name: Protector
options.summary: The cannon and any creatures you pick within 10 ft of it gain 1d8 + INT mod (min 1) temp HP.

features.name: Arcane Firearm
features.summary: After a Long Rest, carve sigils into a Wand, Rod, Staff or Martial Ranged weapon to make your firearm; it is a focus, and Artificer spells cast through it add 1d8 to one damage roll.

features.name: Explosive Cannon
features.summary: Your cannons hit harder (+1d8 to damage and Protector's temp HP) and can be blown up on purpose.

options.name: Detonate
options.summary: Reaction when your cannon takes damage and you're within 60 ft: it explodes, and creatures within 20 ft make a DEX save, taking 3d10 Force on a fail or half on a success.

options.name: Firepower
options.summary: Add 1d8 to the cannon's damage rolls and to Protector's temp HP.

features.name: Fortified Position
features.summary: Run two cannons at once and shield allies around them.

options.name: Double Firepower
options.summary: Keep two cannons, create both with one Magic action (a second slot if the first cost one), and fire both with one Bonus Action in any modes. Never three.

options.name: Shimmering Field Projection
options.summary: You and allies within 10 ft of your cannon have Half Cover.

summary: A ranged specialist who deploys a magical cannon and channels extra damage through a carved arcane firearm.

name: Battle Smith

features.name: Tools of the Trade
features.summary: Smith's Tools proficiency (or another Artisan's Tool if you had it). Crafting weapons takes half the time.

features.name: Battle Smith Spells
features.summary: Always prepared at levels 3, 5, 9, 13 and 17: Heroism, Shield; Shining Smite, Warding Bond; Aura of Vitality, Conjure Barrage; Aura of Purity, Fire Shield; Banishing Smite, Mass Cure Wounds.

features.name: Battle Ready
features.summary: Martial weapon proficiency; any proficient weapon can be your focus; attacks with magic weapons may use INT for attack and damage.

features.name: Steel Defender
features.summary: A loyal Medium construct (AC 12 + INT, HP 5 + 5 × Artificer level, Speed 40) acts on your turn and only Dodges unless you spend a Bonus Action to command it. Revive it within an hour with a Magic action and a spell slot; rebuild it after a Long Rest with Smith's Tools.

options.name: Force-Empowered Rend
options.summary: Melee attack using your spell attack bonus, reach 5 ft: 1d8 + 2 + INT mod Force.

options.name: Repair
options.summary: The defender, or a Construct or object within 5 ft, heals 2d8 + INT mod. 3 per day.

options.name: Deflect Attack
options.summary: Reaction when a creature within 5 ft attacks someone else: that roll has Disadvantage.

options.name: Steel Bond
options.summary: The defender adds your Proficiency Bonus to its checks and saves.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.summary: Attack twice with the Attack action on your turn; you can trade one of those attacks for the Steel Defender's Rend.

features.name: Arcane Jolt
features.summary: When your magic weapon or your defender hits, channel a burst: extra Force damage to the target or healing to someone within 30 ft. Once per turn, INT mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

options.name: Destructive Energy
options.summary: The target takes +2d6 Force.

options.name: Restorative Energy
options.summary: A creature or object you see within 30 ft of the target regains 2d6 HP.

features.name: Improved Defender
features.summary: Arcane Jolt grows to 4d6, and Deflect Attack hurts the attacker.

options.name: Improved Jolt
options.summary: Arcane Jolt's damage and healing become 4d6.

options.name: Improved Deflection
options.summary: Each Deflect Attack deals 1d4 + INT mod Force to the attacker.

summary: A fighting medic and guardian who wields magic weapons with INT and fights beside a built Steel Defender.

name: Cartographer

features.name: Tools of the Trade
features.summary: Proficiency with Calligrapher's Supplies and Cartographer's Tools (another Artisan's Tool for each you already had). Scribing Spell Scrolls takes half the time.

features.name: Cartographer Spells
features.summary: Always prepared at levels 3, 5, 9, 13 and 17: Faerie Fire, Guiding Bolt, Healing Word; Locate Object, Mind Spike; Call Lightning, Clairvoyance; Banishment, Locate Creature; Scrying, Teleportation Circle.

features.name: Adventurer’s Atlas
features.summary: After a Long Rest with Cartographer's Tools, hand magic maps to 2 to 1 + INT mod creatures (yourself allowed). They last until you die or remake them; holders roll +1d4 Initiative and always know where the other holders are.

options.name: Awareness
options.summary: Map holders add 1d4 to Initiative.

options.name: Positioning
options.summary: Holders sense each other's location on the same plane, and can target one another with sight-based effects despite no line of sight or cover, if within range.

features.name: Mapping Magic
features.summary: Cast Faerie Fire with no slot INT mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, and spend half your Speed to teleport short hops.

options.name: Illuminated Cartography
options.summary: Free castings of Faerie Fire, INT mod (min 1) per Long Rest.

options.name: Portal Jump
options.summary: On your turn, use half your Speed to teleport to a space you see within 10 ft, or next to a map holder within 30 ft. Not usable at Speed 0.

features.name: Guided Precision
features.summary: Once per turn, add your INT mod to one damage roll of a Cartographer spell or of an attack hitting a creature under your Faerie Fire. Damage never breaks your Concentration on Faerie Fire.

features.name: Ingenious Movement
features.summary: Using Flash of Genius also lets you or a willing creature you see within 30 ft teleport up to 30 ft to a space you can see.

features.name: Superior Atlas
features.summary: Maps can save a falling holder, and you get a free Find the Path once per Long Rest.

options.name: Safe Haven
options.summary: A holder dropped to 0 HP (not killed outright) can tear up its map to go to twice your Artificer level in HP instead and teleport beside you or another holder.

options.name: Unerring Path
options.summary: While you hold a map, cast Find the Path once per Long Rest with no slot, preparation or components.

summary: A navigator and scout who links allies with magic maps, marks foes with light, and steps through short portals.

name: Path of the Berserker
text: _Channel Rage into Violent Fury_ Barbarians who walk the Path of the Berserker direct their Rage primarily toward violence. Their path is one of untrammeled fury, and they thrill in the chaos of battle as they allow their Rage to seize and empower them.

features.name: Frenzy
features.text: If you use Reckless Attack while your Rage is active, you deal extra damage to the first target you hit on your turn with a Strength-based attack. To determine the extra damage, roll a number of d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus, and add them together. The damage has the same type as the weapon or Unarmed Strike used for the attack.

features.name: Mindless Rage
features.text: You have Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions while your Rage is active. If you’re Charmed or Frightened when you enter your Rage, the condition ends on you.

features.name: Retaliation
features.text: When you take damage from a creature that is within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to make one melee attack against that creature, using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike.

features.name: Intimidating Presence
features.text:
As a Bonus Action, you can strike terror into others with your menacing presence and primal power. When you do so, each creature of your choice in a 30-foot Emanation originating from you must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus your Strength modifier and Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, a creature has the Frightened condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of the Frightened creature’s turns, the creature repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a Long Rest unless you expend a use of your Rage (no action required) to restore your use of it.

name: Path of the Wild Heart

features.name: Animal Speaker
features.summary: Cast Beast Sense and Speak with Animals, as Rituals only, using Wisdom.

features.name: Rage of the Wilds
features.summary: Each time you start a Rage, pick one animal benefit (Bear, Eagle or Wolf) that lasts while it's active.

options.name: Bear
options.summary: While raging, resist all damage types but Force, Necrotic, Psychic and Radiant.

options.name: Eagle
options.summary: Dash and Disengage as part of the Bonus Action that starts the Rage; while raging, a Bonus Action does both again.

options.name: Wolf
options.summary: While raging, allies attack with Advantage against your enemies within 5 ft of you.

features.name: Aspect of the Wilds
features.summary: Pick one lasting animal trait (Owl, Panther or Salmon); swap it after any Long Rest.

options.name: Owl
options.summary: Darkvision 60 ft, or +60 ft to Darkvision you already have.

options.name: Panther
options.summary: Climb Speed equal to your Speed.

options.name: Salmon
options.summary: Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

features.name: Nature Speaker
features.summary: Cast Commune with Nature, as a Ritual only, using Wisdom.

features.name: Power of the Wilds
features.summary: Each time you start a Rage, also pick Falcon, Lion or Ram for a stronger animal benefit while it lasts.

options.name: Falcon
options.summary: While raging and wearing no armor, fly at your Speed.

options.name: Lion
options.summary: While raging, enemies within 5 ft have Disadvantage attacking anyone but you or another Barbarian using Lion.

options.name: Ram
options.summary: While raging, a melee hit can knock a Large or smaller target Prone.

summary: A barbarian who feels kinship with beasts: talks to animals and takes on an animal's gifts each time they rage.

name: Path of the World Tree

features.name: Vitality of the Tree
features.summary: Starting a Rage gives you temp HP equal to your Barbarian level; while raging you can hand temp HP to an ally nearby each turn.

options.name: Vitality Surge
options.summary: Gain temp HP equal to your Barbarian level whenever you start a Rage.

options.name: Life-Giving Force
options.summary: At the start of each raging turn, one other creature within 10 ft gains temp HP: roll d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus. They vanish when the Rage ends.

features.name: Branches of the Tree
features.summary: Reaction while raging, when a creature you see starts its turn within 30 ft: it makes a STR save or is pulled next to you, and you may drop its Speed to 0 for the turn.

features.name: Battering Roots
features.summary: On your turn, Heavy or Versatile melee weapons get +10 ft reach, and a hit with one can also apply Push or Topple alongside its usual mastery.

features.name: Travel along the Tree
features.summary: When you start a Rage, and as a Bonus Action while raging, teleport up to 60 ft. Once per Rage, make it 150 ft and take up to six willing creatures within 10 ft.

summary: A barbarian bound to the cosmic tree, whose Rage shares life force and teleports foes and friends.

name: Path of the Zealot

features.name: Divine Fury
features.summary: While raging, your first weapon or Unarmed Strike hit each turn adds 1d6 + half your Barbarian level, Necrotic or Radiant (pick each time).

features.name: Warrior of the Gods
features.summary: Pool of d12 healing dice (4, rising to 5 at level 6, 6 at 12, 7 at 17). Bonus Action: spend any number, roll and heal that much. Refills on a Long Rest.

features.name: Fanatical Focus
features.summary: Once per Rage, reroll a failed save adding your Rage Damage bonus; the new roll stands.

features.name: Zealous Presence
features.summary: Bonus Action: up to ten other creatures within 60 ft get Advantage on attacks and saves until your next turn starts. Once per Long Rest, or spend a Rage use to reuse it.
features.duration: until the start of your next turn

features.name: Rage of the Gods
features.summary: On starting a Rage, become a divine warrior for 1 minute (or until 0 HP): flight, divine resistances, and a Rage-fuelled save for dying allies. Once per Long Rest.

options.name: Flight
options.summary: Fly at your Speed and hover.

options.name: Resistance
options.summary: Resist Necrotic, Psychic and Radiant damage.

options.name: Revivification
options.summary: When a creature within 30 ft would hit 0 HP, spend a Rage use to set its HP to your Barbarian level instead.

summary: A barbarian whose Rage is divine ecstasy, adding holy damage, self-healing and a winged battle form.

name: College of Dance

features.name: Dazzling Footwork
features.summary: Without armor or a Shield: Advantage on dance Performance checks, AC 10 + DEX + CHA, a free Unarmed Strike when you spend Bardic Inspiration, and Unarmed Strikes that use DEX and your Bardic Die.

options.name: Dance Virtuoso
options.summary: Advantage on Charisma (Performance) checks made by dancing.

options.name: Unarmored Defense
options.summary: Base AC is 10 + DEX + CHA.

options.name: Agile Strikes
options.summary: Spending a Bardic Inspiration use as part of an action, Bonus Action or Reaction lets you also make one Unarmed Strike with it.

options.name: Bardic Damage
options.summary: Unarmed Strikes can attack with DEX and deal a roll of your Bardic Die + DEX as Bludgeoning damage; this roll costs no die.

features.name: Inspiring Movement
features.summary: Reaction when an enemy you see ends its turn within 5 ft: spend a Bardic Inspiration use to move half your Speed, and one ally within 30 ft may use their Reaction to do the same. None of it provokes.

features.name: Tandem Footwork
features.summary: On rolling Initiative (if not Incapacitated), spend a Bardic Inspiration use and roll the die: you and allies within 30 ft who see or hear you add it to Initiative.

features.name: Leading Evasion
features.summary: DEX saves for half damage: take none on a success, half on a failure. Creatures within 5 ft making the same save can share it. Not while Incapacitated.

summary: A bard who performs through movement: fights unarmored with graceful strikes and moves the party around the battlefield.

name: College of Glamour

features.name: Beguiling Magic
features.summary: Charm Person and Mirror Image always prepared. Right after casting an Enchantment or Illusion spell with a slot, one creature within 60 ft makes a WIS save or is Charmed or Frightened (your pick) for 1 minute, saving again each turn. Once per Long Rest; a Bardic Inspiration use restores it.

features.name: Mantle of Inspiration
features.summary: Bonus Action: spend a Bardic Inspiration use and roll it. Up to CHA mod (min 1) other creatures within 60 ft gain temp HP equal to twice the roll, then may use their Reaction to move their Speed without provoking.

features.name: Mantle of Majesty
features.summary: Command always prepared. Bonus Action: cast it free and look otherworldly for 1 minute (Concentration), casting it free as a Bonus Action each turn; creatures you've Charmed fail its save. Once per Long Rest; a level 3+ slot restores it.

features.name: Unbreakable Majesty
features.summary: Bonus Action: for 1 minute (ends if Incapacitated), the first creature to hit you with an attack each turn must pass a CHA save or the attack misses. Once per Short or Long Rest.

summary: A bard steeped in fey magic who charms and frightens, grants temp HP, and wraps themselves in an awe-inspiring presence.

name: College of Lore
text: _Plumb the Depths of Magical Knowledge_ Bards of the College of Lore collect spells and secrets from diverse sources, such as scholarly tomes, mystical rites, and peasant tales. The college’s members gather in libraries and universities to share their lore with one another. They also meet at festivals or affairs of state, where they can expose corruption, unravel lies, and poke fun at self-important figures of authority.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.text: You gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.

features.name: Cutting Words
features.text: You learn to use your wit to supernaturally distract, confuse, and otherwise sap the confidence and competence of others. When a creature that you can see within 60 feet of yourself makes a damage roll or succeeds on an ability check or attack roll, you can take a Reaction to expend one use of your Bardic Inspiration; roll your Bardic Inspiration die, and subtract the number rolled from the creature’s roll, reducing the damage or potentially turning the success into a failure.

features.name: Magical Discoveries
features.text:
You learn two spells of your choice. These spells can come from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard spell list or any combination thereof (see a class’s section for its spell list). A spell you choose must be a cantrip or a spell for which you have spell slots, as shown in the Bard Features table.

You always have the chosen spells prepared, and whenever you gain a Bard level, you can replace one of the spells with another spell that meets these requirements.

choices.label: Magical Discoveries (Cleric, Druid or Wizard list; cantrips allowed)

features.name: Peerless Skill
features.text: When you make an ability check or attack roll and fail, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration; roll the Bardic Inspiration die, and add the number rolled to the d20, potentially turning a failure into a success. On a failure, the Bardic Inspiration isn’t expended.

name: College of Valor

features.name: Combat Inspiration
features.summary: Anyone holding your Bardic Inspiration die can also spend it to boost AC against a hit (Reaction) or add it to damage after a hit.

options.name: Defense
options.summary: When hit by an attack roll, roll the die and add it to AC against that attack, maybe turning it into a miss.

options.name: Offense
options.summary: Right after hitting with an attack roll, roll the die and add it to that attack's damage.

features.name: Martial Training
features.summary: Proficiency with Martial weapons plus Medium armor and Shield training; Simple or Martial weapons can serve as your Bard spellcasting focus.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.summary: Attack twice when you take the Attack action; one attack can be swapped for a one-action cantrip.

features.name: Battle Magic
features.summary: After casting a spell that takes an action, make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action.

summary: A battle-ready bard who fights in the front line and lets allies spend inspiration on armor or damage.

name: Life Domain
text:
_Soothe the Hurts of the World_ The Life Domain focuses on the positive energy that helps sustain all life in the multiverse. Clerics who tap into this domain are masters of healing, using that life force to cure many hurts.

Existence itself relies on the positive energy associated with this domain, so a Cleric of almost any religious tradition might choose it. This domain is particularly associated with agricultural deities, gods of healing or endurance, and gods of home and community. Religious orders of healing also seek the magic of this domain.

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.text: When a spell you cast with a spell slot restores Hit Points to a creature, that creature regains additional Hit Points on the turn you cast the spell. The additional Hit Points equal 2 plus the spell slot’s level.

features.name: Life Domain Spells
features.text:
Your connection to this divine domain ensures you always have certain spells ready. When you reach a Cleric level specified in the Life Domain Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

**Life Domain Spells**

| Cleric | Prepared Spells |
| --- | --- |

**Level**

| 3 | Aid, Bless, Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration |
| --- | --- |
| 5 | Mass Healing Word, Revivify |
| 7 | Aura of Life, Death Ward |
| 9 | Greater Restoration, Mass Cure Wounds |

features.name: Preserve Life
features.text: As a Magic action, you present your Holy Symbol and expend a use of your Channel Divinity to evoke healing energy that can restore a number of Hit Points equal to five times your Cleric level. Choose Bloodied creatures within 30 feet of yourself (which can include you), and divide those Hit Points among them. This feature can restore a creature to no more than half its Hit Point maximum.

features.name: Blessed Healer
features.text: The healing spells you cast on others heal you as well. Immediately after you cast a spell with a spell slot that restores Hit Points to one or more creatures other than yourself, you regain Hit Points equal to 2 plus the spell slot’s level.

features.name: Supreme Healing
features.text: When you would normally roll one or more dice to restore Hit Points to a creature with a spell or Channel Divinity, don’t roll those dice for the healing; instead use the highest number possible for each die. For example, instead of restoring 2d6 Hit Points to a creature with a spell, you restore 12.

name: Light Domain

features.name: Light Domain Spells
features.summary: Fire, light and seeing spells join your prepared list for free at Cleric levels 3, 5, 7 and 9 (see the domain spell list).

features.name: Radiance of the Dawn
features.summary: Magic action, spend a Channel Divinity use: dispel magical Darkness in a 30-ft Emanation, and chosen creatures there make a CON save, taking 2d10 + Cleric level Radiant (half on a success).

features.name: Warding Flare
features.summary: Reaction: give Disadvantage to an attack roll made by a creature you see within 30 ft. WIS mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Improved Warding Flare
features.summary: Warding Flare now refills on a Short or Long Rest, and each use can give the attack's target 2d6 + WIS mod temp HP.

features.name: Corona of Light
features.summary: Magic action: shed sunlight for 1 minute (60 ft bright, 30 ft more dim); enemies in the bright part have Disadvantage on saves against Radiance of the Dawn and your Fire or Radiant spells. WIS mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

summary: A cleric of radiance and revelation who scorches foes with fire and light and shields allies with flashes of glare.

name: Trickery Domain

features.name: Blessing of the Trickster
features.summary: Magic action: you or a willing creature within 30 ft gets Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks until your next Long Rest or until you use this again.

features.name: Trickery Domain Spells
features.summary: Deception, stealth and mind spells join your prepared list for free at Cleric levels 3, 5, 7 and 9 (see the domain spell list).

features.name: Invoke Duplicity
features.summary: Bonus Action, spend a Channel Divinity use: make an intangible illusion of yourself within 30 ft for 1 minute. Cast spells from its space, gain Advantage on foes next to both of you, and move it 30 ft as a Bonus Action.

options.name: Cast Spells
options.summary: Cast spells as if standing where the illusion is, using your own senses.

options.name: Distract
options.summary: Advantage on attacks against a creature that sees the illusion when you and it are both within 5 ft of that creature.

options.name: Move
options.summary: Bonus Action: shift the illusion up to 30 ft to a space you see within 120 ft.

features.name: Trickster’s Transposition
features.summary: When you use the Bonus Action to create or move your Invoke Duplicity illusion, you can also teleport to swap places with it.

features.name: Improved Duplicity
features.summary: You and allies get Advantage attacking creatures within 5 ft of your illusion, and when it ends, you or someone within 5 ft of it heals HP equal to your Cleric level.

options.name: Shared Distraction
options.summary: Attack rolls by you and your allies against a creature within 5 ft of the illusion have Advantage.

options.name: Healing Illusion
options.summary: As the illusion ends, you or a chosen creature within 5 ft of it regains HP equal to your Cleric level.

summary: A mischievous cleric of deception and stealth who fights through an illusory double.

name: War Domain

features.name: Guided Strike
features.summary: Spend a Channel Divinity use to add +10 to a missed attack roll by you or a creature within 30 ft; helping someone else costs your Reaction.

features.name: War Domain Spells
features.summary: Combat and protection spells join your prepared list for free at Cleric levels 3, 5, 7 and 9 (see the domain spell list).

features.name: War Priest
features.summary: Bonus Action: one attack with a weapon or Unarmed Strike. WIS mod uses (min 1), back on a Short or Long Rest.

features.name: War God’s Blessing
features.summary: Pay a Channel Divinity use in place of a slot for Shield of Faith or Spiritual Weapon. Then it skips Concentration and runs 1 minute, ending early if you recast it, become Incapacitated or die.

features.name: Avatar of Battle
features.summary: Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage.

summary: A battle priest who makes extra attacks, guides strikes home and channels divinity into combat spells.

name: Circle of the Land
text: _Celebrate Connection to the Natural World_ The Circle of the Land comprises mystics and sages who safeguard ancient knowledge and rites. These Druids meet within sacred circles of trees or standing stones to whisper primal secrets in Druidic. The circle’s wisest members preside as the chief priests of their communities.

features.name: Circle of the Land Spells
features.text:
Whenever you finish a Long Rest, choose one type of land: arid, polar, temperate, or tropical. Consult the table below that corresponds to the chosen type; you have the spells listed for your Druid level and lower prepared.

**Arid Land**

| Druid Level | Circle Spells |
| --- | --- |
| 3 | Blur, Burning Hands, Fire Bolt |
| 5 | Fireball |
| 7 | Blight |
| 9 | Wall of Stone |

**Polar Land**

| Druid Level | Circle Spells |
| --- | --- |
| 3 | Fog Cloud, Hold Person, Ray of Frost |
| 5 | Sleet Storm |
| 7 | Ice Storm |
| 9 | Cone of Cold |

**Temperate Land**

| Druid Level | Circle Spells |
| --- | --- |
| 3 | Misty Step, Shocking Grasp, Sleep |
| 5 | Lightning Bolt |
| 7 | Freedom of Movement |
| 9 | Tree Stride |

**Tropical Land**

| Druid Level | Circle Spells |
| --- | --- |
| 3 | Acid Splash, Ray of Sickness, Web |
| 5 | Stinking Cloud |
| 7 | Polymorph |
| 9 | Insect Plague |

features.name: Land’s Aid
features.text:
As a Magic action, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape and choose a point within 60 feet of yourself. Vitality-giving flowers and life-draining thorns appear for a moment in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point. Each creature of your choice in the Sphere must make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC, taking 2d6 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. One creature of your choice in that area regains 2d6 Hit Points.

The damage and healing increase by 1d6 when you reach Druid levels 10 (3d6) and 14 (4d6).

features.name: Natural Recovery
features.text:
You can cast one of the level 1+ spells that you have prepared from your Circle Spells feature without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a Long Rest before you do so again.

In addition, when you finish a Short Rest, you can choose expended spell slots to recover. The spell slots can have a combined level that is equal to or less than half your Druid level (round up), and none of them can be level 6+. For example, if you’re a level 6 Druid, you can recover up to three levels’ worth of spell slots. You can recover a level 3 spell slot, a level 2 and a level 1 spell slot, or three level 1 spell slots. Once you recover spell slots with this feature, you can’t do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Nature’s Ward
features.text:
You are immune to the Poisoned condition, and you have Resistance to a damage type associated with your current land choice in the Circle Spells feature, as shown in the Nature’s Ward table.

**Nature’s Ward**

| Land Type | Resistance | Land Type | Resistance |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Arid | Fire | Temperate | Lightning |
| Polar | Cold | Tropical | Poison |

features.name: Nature’s Sanctuary
features.text:
As a Magic action, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape and cause spectral trees and vines to appear in a 15-foot Cube on the ground within 120 feet of yourself. They last there for 1 minute or until you have the Incapacitated condition or die. You and your allies have Half Cover while in that area, and your allies gain the current Resistance of your Nature’s Ward while there.

As a Bonus Action, you can move the Cube up to 60 feet to ground within 120 feet of yourself.

name: Circle of the Moon

features.name: Circle Forms
features.summary: Shape-shifted, your top form CR is Druid level ÷ 3 (round down), your AC is the beast's or 13 + WIS, whichever is higher, and you get temp HP of 3 × Druid level.

features.name: Circle of the Moon Spells
features.summary: Always prepared: Cure Wounds, Moonbeam, Starry Wisp at 3; Conjure Animals at 5; Fount of Moonlight at 7; Mass Cure Wounds at 9. These work even in Wild Shape.

features.name: Improved Circle Forms
features.summary: In beast form, each hit can deal Radiant instead of its usual type (pick per hit), and you add WIS to CON saves.

features.name: Moonlight Step
features.summary: Bonus Action: teleport up to 30 ft to a space you see; your next attack roll this turn has Advantage. WIS mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest; a level 2+ slot buys back one use.

uses.restore: a level 2+ spell slot per use

features.name: Lunar Form
features.summary: Once per turn a beast-form hit adds 2d10 Radiant. Moonlight Step can bring a willing creature within 10 ft along, setting it down within 10 ft of where you arrive.

summary: A shape-shifter whose lunar magic makes Wild Shape forms tougher, deadlier and able to cast circle spells.

name: Circle of the Sea

features.name: Circle of the Sea Spells
features.summary: Always-prepared spells by Druid level. 3: Thunderwave, Ray of Frost, Fog Cloud, Gust of Wind. 5: Water Breathing, Lightning Bolt. 7: Ice Storm, Control Water. 9: Hold Monster, Conjure Elemental.

features.name: Wrath of the Sea
features.summary: Bonus Action, spend a Wild Shape use: a 5-ft spray aura around you for 10 min. On creation and as a later Bonus Action, one creature in it makes a CON save or takes (WIS mod, min 1)d6 Cold; Large or smaller is shoved up to 15 ft.

features.name: Aquatic Affinity
features.summary: The Wrath of the Sea aura grows to 10 ft, and you swim at your walking Speed.

features.name: Stormborn
features.summary: While Wrath of the Sea is up, you fly at your Speed and resist Cold, Lightning and Thunder.

features.name: Oceanic Gift
features.summary: You may center Wrath of the Sea on a willing creature within 60 ft; it uses your save DC and WIS. Spending two Wild Shape uses gives the aura to both of you.

summary: A storm-caller who spends Wild Shape on a freezing aura of sea spray that batters foes.

name: Circle of the Stars

features.name: Star Map
features.summary: You own a Tiny star chart that works as a Druid focus. Holding it, you have Guidance and Guiding Bolt prepared and cast Guiding Bolt slot-free WIS mod times (min 1) per Long Rest. Remake a lost one in a 1-hour rite during a rest.

features.name: Starry Form
features.summary: Bonus Action, spend a Wild Shape use: glow for 10 min (bright light 10 ft, dim 10 ft past that) and keep your own stats instead of changing shape. Each time, pick a constellation: Archer, Chalice or Dragon.

options.name: Archer
options.summary: When you take the form and as a Bonus Action later: ranged spell attack vs one creature within 60 ft, 1d8 + WIS Radiant.

options.name: Chalice
options.summary: When a spell cast with a slot heals someone, you or a creature within 30 ft also heals 1d8 + WIS.

options.name: Dragon
options.summary: On INT or WIS checks and CON saves to hold Concentration, a d20 of 9 or less counts as 10.

features.name: Cosmic Omen
features.summary: After each Long Rest roll a die: even means Weal, odd means Woe until your next one. Reaction when a creature you see within 30 ft makes a D20 Test: roll 1d6 to add (Weal) or subtract (Woe). WIS mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

options.name: Weal
options.summary: Even roll: your 1d6 goes onto the creature's D20 Test.

options.name: Woe
options.summary: Odd roll: your 1d6 comes off the creature's D20 Test.

features.name: Twinkling Constellations
features.summary: Archer and Chalice roll 2d8 instead of 1d8; with Dragon you fly 20 ft and can hover. At the start of each of your turns in Starry Form you may switch constellation.

features.name: Full of Stars
features.summary: In Starry Form you resist Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage.

summary: A stargazer who carries a star chart, reads daily omens and takes on a glowing constellation form.

name: Battle Master

features.name: Combat Superiority
features.summary: Pick 3 maneuvers (2 more at Fighter 7, 10 and 15, each time also swapping one) and get four d8 Superiority Dice (five at 7, six at 15), all back on a Short or Long Rest. One maneuver per attack; save DC 8 + PB + STR or DEX.

features.name: Student of War
features.summary: Gain one Artisan's Tools proficiency and one skill from the Fighter's level 1 skill list.

features.name: Know Your Enemy
features.summary: Bonus Action: learn a visible creature's Immunities, Resistances and Vulnerabilities, if any, within 30 ft. Once per Long Rest, or spend a Superiority Die to use it again.

features.name: Improved Combat Superiority
features.summary: Superiority Dice become d10s.

features.name: Relentless
features.summary: Once per turn, fuel a maneuver with a free 1d8 roll instead of spending a Superiority Die.

features.name: Ultimate Combat Superiority
features.summary: Superiority Dice become d12s.

summary: A tactician who spends Superiority Dice on combat maneuvers that trip, push, rally and outwit.

name: Champion
text: _Pursue Physical Excellence in Combat_ A Champion focuses on the development of martial prowess in a relentless pursuit of victory. Champions combine rigorous training with physical excellence to deal devastating blows, withstand peril, and garner glory. Whether in athletic contests or bloody battle, Champions strive for the crown of the victor.

features.name: Improved Critical
features.text: Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes can score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.

features.name: Remarkable Athlete
features.text:
Thanks to your athleticism, you have Advantage on Initiative rolls and Strength (Athletics) checks.

In addition, immediately after you score a Critical Hit, you can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Additional Fighting Style
features.text: You gain another Fighting Style feat of your choice.

features.name: Heroic Warrior
features.text: The thrill of battle drives you toward victory. During combat, you can give yourself Heroic Inspiration whenever you start your turn without it.

features.name: Superior Critical
features.text: Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes can now score a Critical Hit on a roll of 18–20 on the d20.

features.name: Survivor
features.text:
You attain the pinnacle of resilience in battle, giving you these benefits.

***Defy Death.*** You have Advantage on Death Saving Throws. Moreover, when you roll 18–20 on a Death Saving Throw, you gain the benefit of rolling a 20 on it.

***Heroic Rally.*** At the start of each of your turns, you regain Hit Points equal to 5 plus your Constitution modifier if you are Bloodied and have at least 1 Hit Point.

name: Eldritch Knight

features.name: Spellcasting
features.summary: Cast Wizard spells with INT as a one-third caster: 2 cantrips (3 at Fighter 10) plus prepared spells and slots from the Eldritch Knight table. Each Fighter level, swap one cantrip and one prepared spell. An Arcane Focus works as your focus.

features.name: War Bond
features.summary: A 1-hour ritual (doable in a Short Rest) binds a weapon to you; up to two at once. You can't be disarmed of it unless Incapacitated, and a Bonus Action teleports one bonded weapon on your plane into your hand.

features.name: War Magic
features.summary: Taking the Attack action, you may trade one attack for casting a Wizard cantrip whose casting time is an action.

features.name: Eldritch Strike
features.summary: Hit a creature with a weapon and it has Disadvantage on its next save against your spell, if you cast it before your next turn ends.
features.duration: until the end of your next turn

features.name: Arcane Charge
features.summary: Whenever you Action Surge, also teleport up to 30 ft to a space you see, before or after the extra action.

features.name: Improved War Magic
features.summary: Taking the Attack action, you may trade two attacks for casting a level 1 or 2 Wizard spell whose casting time is an action.

summary: A fighter who backs up weapon skill with wizard spells, mostly protective and explosive ones.

name: Psi Warrior

features.name: Psionic Power
features.summary: You get Psionic Energy Dice: 4d6 at Fighter 3, 6d8 at 5, 8d8 at 9, 8d10 at 11, 10d10 at 13, 12d12 at 17. A Short Rest returns one, a Long Rest all. They fuel Protective Field, Psionic Strike and Telekinetic Movement.

options.name: Protective Field
options.summary: Reaction when you or a visible creature within 30 ft takes damage: spend a die and cut the damage by its roll + INT (min 1).

options.name: Psionic Strike
options.summary: Once per turn, right after a weapon hit on a target within 30 ft, spend a die to add its roll + INT as Force damage.

options.name: Telekinetic Movement
options.summary: Magic action: move a loose Large or smaller object or a willing other creature within 30 ft up to 30 ft, or pull a Tiny object to or from your hand. Once per Short or Long Rest, or spend a die to use it again.

features.name: Telekinetic Adept
features.summary: Two new psionic tricks: a Bonus Action leap that lets you fly, and a shove added to Psionic Strike.

options.name: Psi-Powered Leap
options.summary: Bonus Action: Fly Speed of twice your Speed until the turn ends. Once per Short or Long Rest, or spend a die to use it again.
options.duration: until the end of the current turn

options.name: Telekinetic Thrust
options.summary: When Psionic Strike deals damage, the target makes a STR save or you knock it Prone or move it up to 10 ft sideways.

features.name: Guarded Mind
features.summary: Resistance to Psychic damage. Starting your turn Charmed or Frightened, you can spend a die to end every effect causing it.

features.name: Bulwark of Force
features.summary: Bonus Action: up to INT mod creatures (min 1) within 30 ft, you included, get Half Cover for 1 minute or until you're Incapacitated. Once per Long Rest, or spend a die to use it again.

features.name: Telekinetic Master
features.summary: Telekinesis is always prepared; cast it with no slot or components, using INT. Each turn you concentrate on it, including the first, you may make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action. Once per Long Rest, or spend a die to cast it again.

summary: A fighter who channels psionic energy dice into force-charged strikes, shields and telekinesis.

name: Warrior of Mercy

features.name: Hand of Harm
features.summary: Once per turn, when an Unarmed Strike damages a creature, pay 1 Focus Point to add one Martial Arts die + WIS of Necrotic damage.

features.name: Hand of Healing
features.summary: Magic action, 1 Focus Point: touch a creature to heal it for one Martial Arts die + WIS. In a Flurry of Blows you can trade one strike for this healing without paying Focus.

features.name: Implements of Mercy
features.summary: Proficiency in Insight, Medicine and the Herbalism Kit.

features.name: Physician’s Touch
features.summary: Hand of Harm can also leave the target Poisoned until your next turn ends. Hand of Healing can also cure one of Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, Poisoned or Stunned on the creature healed.
features.duration: until the end of your next turn

features.name: Flurry of Healing and Harm
features.summary: During Flurry of Blows, swap any of its strikes for free Hand of Healing uses, or add Hand of Harm to a damaging strike without paying Focus (still once per turn). WIS mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Hand of Ultimate Mercy
features.summary: Magic action, 5 Focus Points, once per Long Rest: touch a creature dead under 24 hours to revive it with 4d10 + WIS HP, free of Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, Poisoned and Stunned.

summary: A monk who heals allies and withers foes with a touch, spending Focus on both.

name: Warrior of Shadow

features.name: Shadow Arts
features.summary: Pay 1 Focus Point to cast Darkness with no components; you see inside it and can shift it within 60 ft at each turn start. Gain 60 ft Darkvision (+60 ft if you have it) and the Minor Illusion cantrip, cast with WIS.

features.name: Shadow Step
features.summary: Bonus Action while in Dim Light or Darkness: teleport up to 60 ft to a dim or dark spot you can see, then get Advantage on your next melee attack this turn.

features.name: Improved Shadow Step
features.summary: Pay 1 Focus Point when you Shadow Step to ignore its light requirement; the same Bonus Action also lets you make an Unarmed Strike right after the teleport.

features.name: Cloak of Shadows
features.summary: Magic action in dim light or darkness, 3 Focus Points: for 1 minute you are Invisible, pass through occupied spaces as Difficult Terrain and use Flurry of Blows for free. Ends early if Incapacitated or you end a turn in Bright Light.

summary: A stealthy monk who wields darkness, teleports between shadows and fades from sight.

name: Warrior of the Elements

features.name: Elemental Attunement
features.summary: At the start of your turn, pay 1 Focus Point for 10 minutes of elemental power: Unarmed Strikes reach 10 ft farther and can deal Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder, and such a hit can force a STR save to move the target 10 ft toward or away.

features.name: Manipulate Elements
features.summary: You know the Elementalism cantrip; WIS is its casting ability.

features.name: Elemental Burst
features.summary: Magic action, 2 Focus Points: a 20-ft-radius burst at a point within 120 ft, of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder. DEX save: three Martial Arts dice on a fail, half on a success.

features.name: Stride of the Elements
features.summary: While Elemental Attunement is on, you have Fly and Swim Speeds equal to your Speed.

features.name: Elemental Epitome
features.summary: While attuned: resist one of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder (switch each turn); Step of the Wind adds 20 ft Speed and hits creatures you move next to for a Martial Arts die (once each per turn); once per turn an Unarmed Strike hit adds a Martial Arts die.

summary: A monk who channels elemental energy into long-reaching strikes and bursts.

name: Warrior of the Open Hand
text: _Master Unarmed Combat Techniques_ Warriors of the Open Hand are masters of unarmed combat. They learn techniques to push and trip their opponents and manipulate their own energy to protect themselves from harm.

features.name: Open Hand Technique
features.text:
Whenever you hit a creature with an attack granted by your Flurry of Blows, you can impose one of the following effects on that target.

***Addle.*** The target can’t make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

***Push.*** The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away from you.

***Topple.*** The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the Prone condition.

features.name: Wholeness of Body
features.text:
You gain the ability to heal yourself. As a Bonus Action, you can roll your Martial Arts die. You regain a number of Hit Points equal to the number rolled plus your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1 Hit Point regained).

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Fleet Step
features.text: When you take a Bonus Action other than Step of the Wind, you can also use Step of the Wind immediately after that Bonus Action.

features.name: Quivering Palm
features.text:
You gain the ability to set up lethal vibrations in someone’s body. When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike, you can expend 4 Focus Points to start these imperceptible vibrations, which last for a number of days equal to your Monk level. The vibrations are harmless unless you take an action to end them. Alternatively, when you take the Attack action on your turn, you can forgo one of the attacks to end the vibrations. To end them, you and the target must be on the same plane of existence. When you end them, the target must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 10d12 Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

You can have only one creature under the effect of this feature at a time. You can end the vibrations harmlessly (no action required).
features.summary: Starting the vibrations costs 4 Focus Points.

name: Oath of Devotion
text:
_Uphold the Ideals of Justice and Order_ The Oath of Devotion binds Paladins to the ideals of justice and order. These Paladins meet the archetype of the knight in shining armor. They hold themselves to the highest standards of conduct, and some—for better or worse—hold the rest of the world to the same standards.

Many who swear this oath are devoted to gods of law and good and use their gods’ tenets as the measure of personal devotion. Others hold angels as their ideals and incorporate images of angelic wings into their helmets or coats of arms.

These paladins share the following tenets:

| • | Let your word be your promise. |
| --- | --- |
| • | Protect the weak and never fear to act. |
| • | Let your honorable deeds be an example. |

features.name: Oath of Devotion Spells
features.text:
The magic of your oath ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Paladin level specified in the Oath of Devotion Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

**Oath of Devotion Spells**

| Paladin Level | Spells |
| --- | --- |
| 3 | Protection from Evil and Good, Shield of Faith |
| 5 | Aid, Zone of Truth |
| 9 | Beacon of Hope, Dispel Magic |
| 13 | Freedom of Movement, |

Guardian of Faith

| 17 | Commune, Flame Strike |
| --- | --- |

features.name: Sacred Weapon
features.text:
When you take the Attack action, you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity to imbue one Melee weapon that you are holding with positive energy. For 10 minutes or until you use this feature again, you add your Charisma modifier to attack rolls you make with that weapon (minimum bonus of +1), and each time you hit with it, you cause it to deal its normal damage type or Radiant damage.

The weapon also emits Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light 20 feet beyond that.

You can end this effect early (no action required). This effect also ends if you aren’t carrying the weapon.
features.summary: Costs one Channel Divinity use.

features.name: Aura of Devotion
features.text: You and your allies have Immunity to the Charmed condition while in your Aura of Protection. If a Charmed ally enters the aura, that condition has no effect on that ally while there.

features.name: Smite of Protection
features.text: Your magical smite now radiates protective energy. Whenever you cast _Divine Smite_, you and your allies have Half Cover while in your Aura of Protection. The aura has this benefit until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Holy Nimbus
features.text:
As a Bonus Action, you can imbue your Aura of Protection with holy power, granting the benefits below for 10 minutes or until you end them (no action required). Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a Long Rest. You can also restore your use of it by expending a level 5 spell slot (no action required).

***Holy Ward.*** You have Advantage on any saving throw you are forced to make by a Fiend or an Undead.

***Radiant Damage.*** Whenever an enemy starts its turn in the aura, that creature takes Radiant damage equal to your Charisma modifier plus your Proficiency Bonus.

***Sunlight.*** The aura is filled with Bright Light that is sunlight.

name: Oath of Glory

features.name: Inspiring Smite
features.summary: Right after casting Divine Smite, spend a Channel Divinity use to split 2d8 + Paladin level Temporary HP among any creatures within 30 ft, you included.

features.name: Oath of Glory Spells
features.summary: Oath spells you always have prepared, gained at Paladin levels 3, 5, 9, 13 and 17.

features.name: Peerless Athlete
features.summary: Bonus Action, one Channel Divinity use: for 1 hour, Advantage on Athletics and Acrobatics checks and +10 ft on Long and High Jumps.

features.name: Aura of Alacrity
features.summary: +10 ft Speed. An ally who first enters your Aura of Protection on a turn, or starts its turn there, gets +10 ft Speed until its next turn ends.

features.name: Glorious Defense
features.summary: Reaction when you or a creature you see within 10 ft is hit: add your CHA mod (min +1) to its AC against that attack; on a miss, make one weapon attack at the attacker if it's in range. CHA mod uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Living Legend
features.summary: Bonus Action, 10 minutes: Advantage on Charisma checks, a Reaction to reroll a failed save, and once per turn a missed weapon attack can hit instead. Once per Long Rest, or spend a level 5 slot to use it again.

summary: A paladin sworn to heroic deeds who bolsters allies' vigor, speed and defense.

name: Oath of the Ancients

features.name: Nature’s Wrath
features.summary: Magic action, one Channel Divinity use: chosen creatures within 15 ft make a STR save or are Restrained for 1 minute, saving again at the end of each of their turns.

features.name: Oath of the Ancients Spells
features.summary: Oath spells you always have prepared, gained at Paladin levels 3, 5, 9, 13 and 17.

features.name: Aura of Warding
features.summary: You and allies inside your Aura of Protection resist Necrotic, Psychic and Radiant damage.

features.name: Undying Sentinel
features.summary: Once per Long Rest, when dropped to 0 HP but not killed, stay at 1 HP and then heal 3 × Paladin level. You also stop aging and can't be aged by magic.

features.name: Elder Champion
features.summary: Bonus Action, 1 minute: foes in your aura have Disadvantage on saves against your spells and Channel Divinity, you regain 10 HP at each turn start, and 1-action spells can be cast as a Bonus Action. Once per Long Rest, or spend a level 5 slot.

summary: A paladin who defends life, light and the natural world with primal magic.

name: Oath of Vengeance

features.name: Oath of Vengeance Spells
features.summary: Oath spells you always have prepared, gained at Paladin levels 3, 5, 9, 13 and 17.

features.name: Vow of Enmity
features.summary: As part of the Attack action, spend a Channel Divinity use to mark a creature within 30 ft: Advantage on attacks against it for 1 minute. If it drops to 0 HP, move the mark to another creature within 30 ft for free.

features.name: Relentless Avenger
features.summary: When your Opportunity Attack hits, the target's Speed becomes 0 for the turn, and that same Reaction lets you move half your Speed without provoking.

features.name: Soul of Vengeance
features.summary: Reaction right after your Vow of Enmity target makes an attack roll, hit or miss: make a melee attack against it if it's in range.

features.name: Avenging Angel
features.summary: Bonus Action, 10 minutes: Fly Speed 60 ft with hover, and foes who start a turn in your aura make a WIS save or are Frightened for 1 minute (ends on damage), with attacks against them at Advantage. Once per Long Rest, or spend a level 5 slot.

summary: A paladin sworn to hunt down and punish grievous evil at any cost.

name: Beast Master

features.name: Primal Companion
features.summary: Summon a primal beast (Land, Sea or Sky) that obeys you and acts on your turn. It only Dodges unless you spend a Bonus Action, or give up one of your attacks, to have it act. Revive it within an hour with a Magic action and a spell slot; swap it on a Long Rest.

options.name: Beast of the Land
options.summary: Medium; AC 13 + WIS; HP 5 + 5 × Ranger level (d8 Hit Dice); Speed 40 ft, climb 40 ft; Darkvision 60 ft. Beast's Strike: 1d8 + 2 + WIS; a 20-ft straight run first adds 1d6 and knocks Large or smaller Prone.

options.name: Beast of the Sea
options.summary: Medium; AC 13 + WIS; HP 5 + 5 × Ranger level (d8 Hit Dice); Speed 5 ft, swim 60 ft; Darkvision 90 ft; breathes air and water. Beast's Strike: 1d6 + 2 + WIS and Grapples (escape DC = your spell save DC).

options.name: Beast of the Sky
options.summary: Small; AC 13 + WIS; HP 4 + 4 × Ranger level (d6 Hit Dice); Speed 10 ft, fly 60 ft; Darkvision 60 ft; flying away never provokes. Beast's Strike: 1d4 + 3 + WIS Slashing.

features.name: Exceptional Training
features.summary: When a Bonus Action commands your beast, it can also Dash, Disengage, Dodge or Help with its own Bonus Action, and its damaging hits may deal Force damage instead.

features.name: Bestial Fury
features.summary: Your beast makes Beast's Strike twice when commanded to use it, and its first hit each turn on your Hunter's Mark target adds that spell's bonus damage as Force.

features.name: Share Spells
features.summary: A spell you cast on yourself can also affect your beast if it's within 30 ft.

summary: A ranger bonded to a primal beast that fights at their command.

name: Fey Wanderer

features.name: Dreadful Strikes
features.summary: Weapon hits can deal an extra 1d4 Psychic damage (1d6 from Ranger level 11); each creature takes it at most once per turn.

features.name: Fey Wanderer Spells
features.summary: Subclass spells always prepared, gained at Ranger levels 3, 5, 9, 13 and 17. You also get a harmless fey quirk, chosen or rolled on a d6 table.

features.name: Otherworldly Glamour
features.summary: Add your WIS mod (min +1) to Charisma checks, and gain proficiency in Deception, Performance or Persuasion.

features.name: Beguiling Twist
features.summary: Advantage on saves to avoid or end Charmed or Frightened. When you or a creature you see within 120 ft succeeds on one, your Reaction makes another creature within 120 ft save WIS or be Charmed or Frightened (your pick) for 1 minute, saving again each turn end.

features.name: Fey Reinforcements
features.summary: Summon Fey needs no Material component, can be cast once per Long Rest without a slot, and can skip Concentration, lasting 1 minute instead.

features.name: Misty Wanderer
features.summary: Cast Misty Step without a slot WIS mod times (min 1) per Long Rest. Any casting can carry one willing creature within 5 ft, which lands within 5 ft of you.

summary: A ranger touched by fey magic who blends charm with terrifying psychic strikes.

name: Gloom Stalker

features.name: Dread Ambusher
features.summary: +10 ft Speed on your first turn of each combat. Once per turn a weapon hit can add 2d6 Psychic (WIS mod uses, min 1, per Long Rest). Add your WIS mod to Initiative rolls.

features.name: Gloom Stalker Spells
features.summary: Subclass spells always prepared, gained at Ranger levels 3, 5, 9, 13 and 17.

features.name: Umbral Sight
features.summary: Gain 60 ft Darkvision (+60 ft if you have it). While fully in Darkness, you're Invisible to creatures that use Darkvision to see you.

features.name: Iron Mind
features.summary: Proficiency in Wisdom saves; if you already have it, pick Intelligence or Charisma saves instead.

features.name: Stalker’s Flurry
features.summary: Dread Ambusher's Psychic damage rises to 2d8, and each time you use it you may add Sudden Strike or Mass Fear.

options.name: Sudden Strike
options.summary: Make one more attack with that weapon at another creature within 5 ft of the first target and within range.

options.name: Mass Fear
options.summary: The target and everyone within 10 ft of it save WIS or are Frightened until your next turn starts.
options.duration: until the start of your next turn

features.name: Shadowy Dodge
features.summary: Reaction when a creature rolls to attack you: give the roll Disadvantage, then teleport up to 30 ft to a space you can see, hit or miss.

summary: A ranger who ambushes foes from the dark with shadow magic and dread.

name: Hunter
text: _Protect Nature and People from Destruction_ You stalk prey in the wilds and elsewhere, using your abilities as a Hunter to protect nature and people everywhere from forces that would destroy them.

features.name: Hunter’s Lore
features.text: You can call on the forces of nature to reveal certain strengths and weaknesses of your prey. While a creature is marked by your _Hunter’s Mark_, you know whether that creature has any Immunities, Resistances, or Vulnerabilities, and if the creature has any, you know what they are.

features.name: Hunter’s Prey
features.text:
You gain one of the following feature options of your choice. Whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest, you can replace the chosen option with the other one.

***Colossus Slayer.*** Your tenacity can wear down even the most resilient foes. When you hit a creature with a weapon, the weapon deals an extra 1d8 damage to the target if it’s missing any of its Hit Points. You can deal this extra damage only once per turn.

***Horde Breaker.*** Once on each of your turns when you make an attack with a weapon, you can make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature that is within 5 feet of the original target, that is within the weapon’s range, and that you haven’t attacked this turn.

features.name: Defensive Tactics
features.text:
You gain one of the following feature options of your choice. Whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest, you can replace the chosen option with the other one.

***Escape the Horde.*** Opportunity Attacks have Disadvantage against you.

***Multiattack Defense.*** When a creature hits you with an attack roll, that creature has Disadvantage on all other attack rolls against you this turn.

features.name: Superior Hunter’s Prey
features.text: Once per turn when you deal damage to a creature marked by your _Hunter’s Mark_, you can also deal that spell’s extra damage to a different creature that you can see within 30 feet of the first creature.

features.name: Superior Hunter’s Defense
features.text: When you take damage, you can take a Reaction to give yourself Resistance to that damage and any other damage of the same type until the end of the current turn.

name: Arcane Trickster

features.name: Spellcasting
features.summary: Third-caster on the Wizard list with INT: Mage Hand plus 2 more Wizard cantrips (one more at Rogue 10) and 3 prepared level 1 Wizard spells, growing per the Arcane Trickster table up to level 4 slots. Swap a cantrip (not Mage Hand) or a spell each Rogue level; an Arcane Focus works.

features.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
features.summary: Mage Hand can be cast as a Bonus Action and made Invisible; steer it as a Bonus Action and use it for Sleight of Hand checks.

features.name: Magical Ambush
features.summary: While you're Invisible, a creature you target with a spell has Disadvantage on its saves against that spell this turn.

features.name: Versatile Trickster
features.summary: When you Trip a creature with Cunning Strike, you may also Trip a second creature within 5 ft of your Mage Hand.

features.name: Spell Thief
features.summary: Reaction after a creature's spell targets or includes you: it makes an INT save vs your spell DC. On a fail the spell doesn't affect you, and if it's a level 1+ spell whose level you have slots for, you keep it prepared for 8 hours while the caster can't use it. 1/Long Rest.

summary: A Rogue who adds Intelligence-based Wizard magic and an unseen Mage Hand to a burglar's toolkit.

name: Assassin

features.name: Assassinate
features.summary: Advantage on Initiative. In combat's first round, Advantage on attacks against creatures that haven't acted yet, and a Sneak Attack hit that round adds damage equal to your Rogue level, of the weapon's type.

features.name: Assassin’s Tools
features.summary: Proficiency with, and one each of, the Disguise Kit and Poisoner's Kit.

features.name: Infiltration Expertise
features.summary: After 1 hour of study you can flawlessly copy a person's voice, handwriting or both, and Steady Aim no longer drops your Speed to 0.

features.name: Envenom Weapons
features.summary: Your Cunning Strike Poison also deals 2d6 Poison damage each time the target fails its save, and that damage bypasses Poison Resistance.

features.name: Death Strike
features.summary: Hit with Sneak Attack in combat's first round: the target makes a CON save (DC 8 + DEX + PB) or takes double the attack's damage.

summary: A Rogue built for ambushes, poison and disguise, striking hardest before foes can act.

name: Soulknife

features.name: Psionic Power
features.summary: Psionic Energy Dice: 4d6 at Rogue 3, 6d8 at 5, 8d8 at 9, 8d10 at 11, 10d10 at 13, 12d12 at 17. Regain one on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest. Fuels this subclass's powers, starting with the two below.

options.name: Psi-Bolstered Knack
options.summary: Failed a check with a proficient skill or tool? Roll a Psionic Energy Die and add it; the die is spent only if that makes it succeed.

options.name: Psychic Whispers
options.summary: Magic action: link up to PB creatures you see telepathically (1 mile reach) for hours equal to a Psionic Energy Die roll.

features.name: Psychic Blades
features.summary: When you Attack or make an Opportunity Attack with a free hand, form a Simple melee blade: 1d6 Psychic + the attack's modifier, Finesse, Thrown 60/120, Vex mastery (free). After it, a Bonus Action attack with a second blade deals 1d4.

features.name: Soul Blades
features.summary: Two new Psychic Blade powers fueled by Psionic Energy Dice.

options.name: Homing Strikes
options.summary: Missed with a Psychic Blade? Roll a Psionic Energy Die and add it to the attack; the die is spent only if it now hits.

options.name: Psychic Teleportation
options.summary: Bonus Action: spend and roll a Psionic Energy Die, then teleport to an unoccupied space you see up to 10 ft × the roll away.

features.name: Psychic Veil
features.summary: Magic action: become Invisible for 1 hour (dismiss anytime); it ends right after you deal damage or force a save. 1/Long Rest, or spend a Psionic Energy Die to use it again.

features.name: Rend Mind
features.summary: When your Psychic Blades deal Sneak Attack damage, the target makes a WIS save (DC 8 + DEX + PB) or is Stunned for 1 minute, repeating the save at each of its turn ends. 1/Long Rest, or spend 3 Psionic Energy Dice to reuse.

summary: A Rogue whose inner psionic power forms blades of mental energy and fuels telepathy and teleportation.

name: Thief
text: _Hunt for Treasure as a Classic Adventurer_ A mix of burglar, treasure hunter, and explorer, you are the epitome of an adventurer. In addition to improving your agility and stealth, you gain abilities useful for delving into ruins and getting maximum benefit from the magic items you find there.

features.name: Fast Hands
features.text:
As a Bonus Action, you can do one of the following.

***Sleight of Hand.*** Make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check to pick a lock or disarm a trap with Thieves’ Tools or to pick a pocket.

***Use an Object.*** Take the Utilize action, or take the Magic action to use a magic item that requires that action.

features.name: Second-Story Work
features.text:
You’ve trained to get into especially hard-to-reach places, granting you these benefits.

***Climber.*** You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.

***Jumper.*** You can determine your jump distance using your Dexterity rather than your Strength.

features.name: Supreme Sneak
features.text:
You gain the following Cunning Strike option.

***Stealth Attack (Cost: 1d6).*** If you have the Hide action’s Invisible condition, this attack doesn’t end that condition on you if you end the turn behind Three-Quarters Cover or Total Cover.

features.name: Use Magic Device
features.text:
You’ve learned how to maximize use of magic items, granting you the following benefits.

***Attunement.*** You can attune to up to four magic items at once.

***Charges.*** Whenever you use a magic item property that expends charges, roll 1d6. On a roll of 6, you use the property without expending the charges.

***Scrolls.*** You can use any _Spell Scroll_, using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability for the spell. If the spell is a cantrip or a level 1 spell, you can cast it reliably. If the scroll contains a higher-level spell, you must first succeed on an Intelligence (Arcana) check (DC 10 plus the spell’s level). On a successful check, you cast the spell from the scroll. On a failed check, the scroll disintegrates.

features.name: Thief’s Reflexes
features.text: You are adept at laying ambushes and quickly escaping danger. You can take two turns during the first round of any combat. You take your first turn at your normal Initiative and your second turn at your Initiative minus 10.

name: Aberrant Sorcery

features.name: Psionic Spells
features.summary: Extra always-prepared spells arrive at Sorcerer levels 3, 5, 7 and 9, ranging from Mind Sliver and Detect Thoughts up to Telekinesis and Telepathic Bond.

features.name: Telepathic Speech
features.summary: Bonus Action: link minds with a creature you see within 30 ft for minutes equal to your Sorcerer level, talking telepathically within CHA miles (min 1) in a shared language. A new link ends the old one.

features.name: Psionic Sorcery
features.summary: Cast your level 1+ Psionic Spells with Sorcery Points equal to the spell's level instead of a slot; cast that way they need no Verbal, Somatic or Material components unless the material is consumed or has a cost.

features.name: Psychic Defenses
features.summary: Resistance to Psychic damage; Advantage on saves to avoid or end Charmed and Frightened.

features.name: Revelation in Flesh
features.summary: Bonus Action: spend 1+ Sorcery Points to transform for 10 minutes, picking one benefit below per point spent.

options.name: Aquatic Adaptation
options.summary: Swim Speed of twice your Speed, and you breathe underwater.

options.name: Glistening Flight
options.summary: Gain a Fly Speed matching your Speed; hovering allowed.

options.name: See the Invisible
options.summary: You see Invisible creatures within 60 ft that lack Total Cover.

options.name: Wormlike Movement
options.summary: Squeeze through 1-inch gaps; spend 5 ft of movement to slip nonmagical restraints or a grapple.

features.name: Warping Implosion
features.summary: Magic action: teleport up to 120 ft to a space you see. Creatures within 30 ft of where you stood make a STR save vs your spell DC: 3d10 Force and pulled toward that spot on a fail, half damage only on a success. 1/Long Rest, or 5 Sorcery Points to reuse.

summary: A Sorcerer touched by alien psionics, with telepathy, mind-bending spells and a body that can mutate at will.

name: Clockwork Sorcery

features.name: Clockwork Spells
features.summary: Extra always-prepared spells arrive at Sorcerer levels 3, 5, 7 and 9, from Aid and Alarm up to Greater Restoration and Wall of Force. Your casting shows a cosmetic sign of order.

features.name: Restore Balance
features.summary: Reaction: a creature you see within 60 ft that would roll a d20 with Advantage or Disadvantage rolls with neither instead. CHA uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Bastion of Law
features.summary: Magic action: spend 1–5 Sorcery Points to ward yourself or a creature within 30 ft with that many d8s. When hurt, the warded creature rolls any number of them to cut the damage. Lasts until your Long Rest or a new ward.

features.name: Trance of Order
features.summary: Bonus Action: for 1 minute, attacks against you can't have Advantage, and your D20 Test rolls of 9 or lower count as 10. 1/Long Rest, or 5 Sorcery Points to reuse.

features.name: Clockwork Cavalcade
features.summary: Magic action: spirits of order fill a 30-ft Cube from you, healing up to 100 HP split as you like, mending objects inside, and ending spells of level 6 or lower on chosen targets. 1/Long Rest, or 7 Sorcery Points to reuse.

summary: A Sorcerer channeling cosmic order to cancel luck, ward allies and impose calm precision.

name: Draconic Sorcery
text: _Breathe the Magic of Dragons_ Your innate magic comes from the gift of a dragon. Perhaps an ancient dragon facing death bequeathed some of its magical power to you or your ancestor. You might have absorbed magic from a site infused with dragons’ power. Or perhaps you handled a treasure taken from a dragon’s hoard that was steeped in draconic power. Or you might have a dragon for an ancestor.

features.name: Draconic Resilience
features.text:
The magic in your body manifests physical traits of your draconic gift. Your Hit Point maximum increases by 3, and it increases by 1 whenever you gain another Sorcerer level.

Parts of you are also covered by dragon-like scales. While you aren’t wearing armor, your base Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Charisma modifiers.

features.name: Draconic Spells
features.text:
When you reach a Sorcerer level specified in the Draconic Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

**Draconic Spells**

**Sorcerer**

| Level | Spells |
| --- | --- |
| 3 | Alter Self, Chromatic Orb, Command, Dragon’s Breath |
| 5 | Fear, Fly |
| 7 | Arcane Eye, Charm Monster |
| 9 | Legend Lore, Summon Dragon |

features.name: Elemental Affinity
features.text:
Your draconic magic has an affinity with a damage type associated with dragons. Choose one of those types: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison.

You have Resistance to that damage type, and when you cast a spell that deals damage of that type, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of that spell.

features.name: Dragon Wings
features.text:
As a Bonus Action, you can cause draconic wings to appear on your back. The wings last for 1 hour or until you dismiss them (no action required). For the duration, you have a Fly Speed of 60 feet.

Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a Long Rest unless you spend 3 Sorcery Points (no action required) to restore your use of it.

features.name: Dragon Companion
features.text:
You can cast _Summon Dragon_ without a Material component. You can also cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a Long Rest.

Whenever you start casting the spell, you can modify it so that it doesn’t require Concentration. If you do so, the spell’s duration becomes 1 minute for that casting.

name: Wild Magic Sorcery

features.name: Wild Magic Surge
features.summary: Once per turn after casting a Sorcerer spell with a slot, you may roll a d20; a 20 means a roll on the surge table. A spell a surge creates can't take Metamagic.

features.name: Tides of Chaos
features.summary: Before a D20 Test, grant yourself Advantage on it. It comes back on a Long Rest or when you next cast a Sorcerer spell with a slot, which also triggers a surge roll.

uses.restore: casting a Sorcerer spell with a spell slot (also rolls a surge)

features.name: Bend Luck
features.summary: Reaction right after another creature you see rolls a D20 Test: spend 1 Sorcery Point and roll 1d4 to add to or subtract from its roll.

features.name: Controlled Chaos
features.summary: Surge table rolls are made twice; you pick which result applies.

features.name: Tamed Surge
features.summary: Right after casting a Sorcerer spell with a slot, choose any surge table effect except the last row instead of rolling (roll any dice it calls for). 1/Long Rest.

summary: A Sorcerer whose chaotic inner magic can erupt in random surges and bend luck.

name: Archfey Patron

features.name: Archfey Spells
